title: Find why rustc keeps crashing with STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION on Windows B, so its compile jobs can be trusted again
outcome: Find why rustc keeps crashing with STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION on Windows B, so its compile jobs can be trusted again
acceptance: The repeat crash is classified from evidence: event and WER records, toolchain hashes before and after the reinstall, and memory, disk and concurrent-build state at the crash
Windows B completes the re-sent N6e job without a compiler crash, or it leaves the rotation for Rust compile jobs with the reason recorded
Nothing beyond the Rust toolset is changed on Windows B without Greg's explicit word, and a hardware or memory check is put to him if the evidence points there
